verdict.rationale: VLP Law Group is a law firm offering legal services, not a software product that collects telemetry, so a telemetry opt-out is the wrong axis for this kind of offering. Its Privacy & Data Security practice advises clients on privacy laws, which is a different service and does not give users a way to opt out of tracking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
